title: Per-Flow Queues
description: Per-Flow Queues is a network ability in the Dynamic Bandwidth Shapers database. Gives every flow its own queue so one greedy flow cannot starve the rest. Flows are hashed to queues; each queue drains in round-robin order. It takes flow table and produces queues. Tunable parameters: hash-based. Guarantee: queues are never shared across flows.

fields.mechanism: Flows are hashed to queues; each queue drains in round-robin order.
fields.guarantees: queues are never shared across flows

demo.code:
function share(total,n){return n?total/n:0;}
console.log('Per-flow share: '+share(17,3)+' Mbps');

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Priority Classes
description: Priority Classes is a network ability in the Dynamic Bandwidth Shapers database. Sorts traffic into priority classes with guaranteed minimums. Classes — realtime, interactive, bulk — each get a minimum bandwidth floor. It takes class tags and produces class queues. Tunable parameters: floors sum ≤ 100%. Guarantee: realtime never drops below its floor.

fields.mechanism: Classes — realtime, interactive, bulk — each get a minimum bandwidth floor.
fields.guarantees: realtime never drops below its floor

title: Token Buckets
description: Token Buckets is a network ability in the Dynamic Bandwidth Shapers database. Polices each flow with a token bucket that allows bursts but caps averages. Tokens accrue at the average rate up to the bucket depth; packets spend tokens. It takes flow config and produces policed flows. Tunable parameters: rate + depth. Guarantee: buckets never go negative.

fields.mechanism: Tokens accrue at the average rate up to the bucket depth; packets spend tokens.

title: Congestion Signals
description: Congestion Signals is a network ability in the Dynamic Bandwidth Shapers database. Emits congestion signals early so senders back off before drops. Queue depth crossings send ECN marks; senders that ignore them face drops. It takes queue depth and produces ECN marks. Tunable parameters: threshold 70%. Guarantee: signals always precede drops.

fields.mechanism: Queue depth crossings send ECN marks; senders that ignore them face drops.

title: Adaptive Rate Limits
description: Adaptive Rate Limits is a network ability in the Dynamic Bandwidth Shapers database. Adjusts rate limits continuously from measured link capacity. Capacity is probed every second; limits track 95% of measured capacity. It takes capacity probes and produces limits. Tunable parameters: 1 s cadence. Guarantee: limits never exceed measured capacity.

fields.mechanism: Capacity is probed every second; limits track 95% of measured capacity.

title: Burst Absorption
description: Burst Absorption is a network ability in the Dynamic Bandwidth Shapers database. Absorbs short bursts without punishing the flow. Bursts within the bucket depth pass untouched; only sustained over-rate is shaped. It takes burst profile and produces smooth output. Tunable parameters: depth-sized. Guarantee: bursts never cause drops.

fields.mechanism: Bursts within the bucket depth pass untouched; only sustained over-rate is shaped.

title: Fair Queueing
description: Fair Queueing is a network ability in the Dynamic Bandwidth Shapers database. Shares leftover bandwidth fairly among backlogged flows. Deficit round-robin visits each backlogged queue in turn with equal quanta. It takes queue set and produces fair shares. Tunable parameters: equal quanta. Guarantee: no backlogged flow is ever skipped.

fields.mechanism: Deficit round-robin visits each backlogged queue in turn with equal quanta.
fields.guarantees: no backlogged flow is ever skipped

title: Latency Targets
description: Latency Targets is a network ability in the Dynamic Bandwidth Shapers database. Shapes bulk traffic to protect interactive latency targets. When interactive latency exceeds target, bulk queues are throttled until it recovers. It takes latency monitor and produces throttled bulk. Tunable parameters: target 50 ms. Guarantee: interactive traffic is never throttled.

title: Per-User Caps
description: Per-User Caps is a network ability in the Dynamic Bandwidth Shapers database. Caps each user's total bandwidth regardless of flow count. User totals are summed across flows; over-cap flows are shaped to fit. It takes user totals and produces capped users. Tunable parameters: per user. Guarantee: caps never affect other users.

title: Shaper Config Versioning
